evals.name: padel-app-demo-login
evals.prompt: Antes de publicar quiero ver cómo se ve mi app en celular chico, celular normal y compu, en modo claro y oscuro. Está en /home/user/mafisa-padel (React + Vite). Sin Firebase configurado arranca en modo demo; para entrar sin login seteá en localStorage 'padel.demoUser' = {"uid":"demo-user","displayName":"Martín","demo":true}. Revisá Inicio, Ranking, Historial y Sorteo. Quiero capturas con lo que falla marcado y un reporte ordenado por prioridad.
evals.expected_output: Annotated screenshots for 4 routes x 3 widths (360/390/1280) x light/dark, taken logged in through the demo user (not a login page), with the real web fonts, and a prioritized report in Spanish.
assertions: Screenshots exist for all 4 routes at 360, 390 and 1280px widths
Both light and dark color schemes were captured and actually differ
Screenshots show the logged-in app (demo user), not a login or landing page
Web fonts (Barlow/Rajdhani from Google Fonts) loaded in the screenshots instead of a fallback font
Problems are marked on the screenshots (boxes/labels drawn on the image)
A written report orders findings by priority/severity
The final answer is in Spanish

evals.name: fixture-planted-bugs
evals.prompt: I have a tiny static site in /home/user/claude-webapp-qa/tools/fixtures (start it with `node serve.mjs 4790` from that folder; pages are /broken and /ok). Check both pages on mobile (360 and 390) and desktop (1280), light and dark, and tell me everything that breaks the layout, most serious first, with screenshots.
evals.expected_output: Finds on /broken: horizontal scroll caused by the 420px .promo banner, the clipped .cta button text, the .tag text spilling out, the ellipsis title, the wrapping .wrap button and the tiny .icon button; reports nothing serious on /ok and does not flag the intentional .scroller.
assertions: Reports horizontal scroll on /broken at 360/390 caused by the .promo banner
Reports the clipped text in the .cta button ('Confirm the reservation')
Reports the 'Registrations open now' text spilling out of .tag
Reports the small .icon close button tap target
Does not report the intentional .scroller as a problem
Reports /ok as having no serious layout problems
Horizontal scroll is ranked above cosmetic issues (ellipsis, tap size)
Annotated screenshots are saved

evals.name: casual-dark-mobile-subset
evals.prompt: che, fijate cómo se ven /ranking y /sorteo de /home/user/mafisa-padel en el celu chico en modo oscuro, me parece que algo se sale. el dev server ya está corriendo en localhost:5173. para entrar: localStorage padel.demoUser = {"uid":"demo-user","displayName":"Martín","demo":true}
evals.expected_output: Uses the running server, checks only /ranking and /sorteo at 360px dark (maybe also 390), answers in Spanish whether something overflows, with marked screenshots.
assertions: Reuses the server already running on localhost:5173 instead of starting another one
Captures /ranking and /sorteo at about 360px width
The captured screenshots are in dark mode
Gives a clear yes/no verdict on whether something overflows, backed by measurements
Answers in Spanish
